analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 41.2 to 50.7, exiting oversold territory. The MACD histogram also improved from -0.6137 to 0.2606, signaling bottoming action. The current price of $253.19 is above the SMA20 ($251.38), indicating potential for continued short-term uptrend.
